## Review
A science book that interestingly explains science in everyday life.  
It unfolds science not as something stiff but as interesting daily life.  
I used to like psychology, but now <mark>brain science</mark> catches my eye more.  
It seems like a more RAW area for understanding humans. Of course, this thought changed a bit after reading <mark>The Selfish Gene</mark>...  
But still, ```brain science``` is interesting.
